usedVsRecon.title: Used or Reconditioned — Which Jaguar Engine to Buy?

options.title: Used Jaguar engines
paragraphs: A used Jaguar engine is a genuine factory-original unit removed from a donor vehicle, inspected, and tested for compression and oil pressure before being offered for sale. Used engines suit budget-conscious buyers or those with lower-mileage vehicles where a direct replacement is preferred. High-supply families like the AJ-V8 5.0 and AJ126 3.0 V6 are frequently available as used units, offering significant savings over recon. All used Jaguar engines come with a standard warranty; specific terms are displayed on each listing.

options.title: Reconditioned Jaguar engines
paragraphs: A reconditioned Jaguar engine is stripped to the bare block, cleaned, and rebuilt with new bearings, piston rings, gaskets, and seals. Every recon unit is assembled to factory tolerances and includes a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty as standard. Known weak points are addressed as part of the rebuild process, giving you a unit that performs like new at a fraction of the cost. Reconditioned engines are ideal for buyers who want maximum reliability and longevity from their replacement engine.

about.title: About Jaguar Engines
paragraphs: Jaguar engines follow a naming system that reflects the brand's engineering heritage: AJ for Advanced Jaguar, with displacement and forced-induction designations. The workhorse families that defined Jaguar's modern UK success include the AJ-V8 5.0 (AJ133), a Jaguar-originated V8 design from 1996 that later powered Range Rover and Range Rover Sport models from 2005 onward. The AJ126 3.0 V6 is a smaller-displacement derivative of the same AJ133 block family, used across XE, XF, F-Pace and F-Type. Legacy V8 and V6 engines from the pre-2010 era remain consistently available as replacement choices for XK, XJ and S-Type models.

Jaguar engines are application-specific: a 5.0 V8 from an XJ may differ in sump, mounts or ancillaries from the same base engine in an F-Type. This is why using your vehicle registration for fitment verification is essential. For cross-brand sourcing, Jaguar engines also appear in other marques: the Ingenium 2.0 and 3.0 diesel and petrol families are shared with Land Rover under the same JLR ownership; the AJD-V6 2.7 and 3.0 TDV6/SDV6 diesel engines are the same physical units as Land Rover's 276DT and 306DT/SDV6 hubs; and the X-Type Duratec and Duratorq engines are shared with Ford (subject to final naming confirmation). Each Jaguar hub page includes full application data so you can be certain the unit you are viewing fits your specific vehicle.

items.title: Warranty & returns
paragraphs: Reconditioned Jaguar engines are supplied with a comprehensive 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty as standard, covering all internal components, cylinder head, and core engine parts against manufacturing defects. faqs.title: Jaguar Engine Buying FAQs
faqs.subtitle: Answers to the most common questions about buying a Jaguar engine from GMC.

items.q: Which Jaguar models does your engine range cover?
items.a: Our Jaguar engine range covers UK-market models from 2000 to the present day, spanning XE, XF, XJ, XK/XKR, F-Type, F-Pace, E-Pace, S-Type and X-Type. This includes both saloon, estate, coupe, convertible and SUV body styles across all major chassis generations. Each engine listing clearly states which chassis and model years it fits, and our registration-based fitment verification tool confirms compatibility for your specific vehicle before you buy.

items.q: What is the difference between used and reconditioned Jaguar engines?
items.a: Used Jaguar engines are removed from donor vehicles, inspected for basic serviceability, and tested for compression and oil pressure before being offered for sale. They are a cost-effective option for many buyers. Reconditioned engines undergo a full strip-down and rebuild, with new bearings, piston rings, gaskets, and seals fitted throughout. Every reconditioned Jaguar engine comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty, whereas used units carry the warranty stated on their individual listing. Reconditioned units are recommended for buyers who want maximum longevity from their replacement engine.

items.q: How do I confirm a Jaguar engine fits my vehicle?
items.a: Enter your vehicle registration number into the fitment checker on any Jaguar engine page. Our system verifies the exact engine code, year, and chassis configuration for your car. Each engine hub also lists all known applications by model, chassis, and year range, so you can cross-reference your specific vehicle. If you are uncertain, our team can confirm fitment before you purchase — contact us through the listing page with your VIN or registration number.

items.q: Which Jaguar engines are shared with other brands?
items.a: Several Jaguar engine families are also fitted to vehicles from other manufacturers. The Ingenium 2.0 and 3.0 diesel and petrol families are shared with Land Rover under the same JLR ownership — the AJ200D/204DTD diesel and AJ200P petrol hubs are already built under Land Rover's BRF. The AJD-V6 2.7 TDV6 and AJD-V6 3.0 TDV6/SDV6 diesel engines are the same physical units as Land Rover's 276DT and 306DT/SDV6 hubs. The AJ-V8 5.0 and AJ126 3.0 V6 are Jaguar-originated and also used by Land Rover. The X-Type Duratec and Duratorq engines are shared with Ford (subject to final naming confirmation). Each hub page lists all cross-brand applications so you can verify fitment regardless of your vehicle's badge.

items.q: What warranty comes with Jaguar engines?
items.a: All reconditioned Jaguar engines include a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty covering internal components, cylinder head, and core engine parts. Used engines carry warranty terms displayed on their individual listing — these vary by age, mileage, and condition of the donor unit. We also offer a 14-day return policy on uninstalled engines. Full warranty terms are provided with every purchase and are available on request before you buy.

items.q: How quickly will my Jaguar engine be delivered?
items.a: In-stock Jaguar engines are dispatched within 2–4 working days of order confirmation. Delivery is to UK mainland addresses via professional pallet courier. You will receive tracking information once your order ships. If your engine is not currently in stock, we will advise you of the expected lead time before you complete your purchase. The delivery price shown at checkout is the price you pay — no surprise fees.
